dedupe_keys.name: 臺北市標線型人行道 cycling and walking networks

description: 臺北市標線型人行道 [cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市交通管制工程處. 標線型人行道圖資(shp格式) 資料欄位說明：標線型人行道圖資(shp格式)，欄位說明：RDITCD(路口碼)、RDCODE(路段碼)、LICODE(圖形標線代碼)、LIAREA(面積)、RDDATE(設置日期)、SIREAN(設置原因代碼)、RDLBLG(長度)、RDLBWT(寬度). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市交通管制工程處. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
